Why choose ElyDoc

Specialist Division — IMC

Our doctors are registered on the Specialist Division for General Practice with the Irish Medical Council.

ICGP Members

Our doctors are full active members of the Irish College of General Practitioners.

Same day appointments

Fast access to specialist GP care for suitable conditions — available today.

Clear clinical boundaries

If you need in-person care your doctor will tell you honestly and signpost you appropriately.

Discreet and GDPR compliant

Your consultation and all clinical information remain strictly confidential and GDPR protected.
